limits: Profile A component uses explicit injected allocation; native harness uses actual malloc/realloc/free, forced-move copy/free and failure injection.
Six native profiles and actual i386 execute the full contract; no target or physical observation is claimed.

Uninitialized-use diagnostic targets are original local processes with synthetic state. Only initialized branches are positive language cases; diagnostic sensitivity is never a golden undefined result.
320 arithmetic boundaries and625 four-event histories per profile are finite independent models, not proof for all allocations/histories.
Raw views must be withdrawn before successful resize; integer pre-release address snapshots do not confer access authority.
Registry identities must be unique for the entire external token lifetime; a moved table uses an explicit current locator, not a stale control pointer.
N1570, C17 issue0400/0451 and N3096 later draft are separate inspected authorities; published C17/C23 remain unavailable.
External review, independent delayed learner assessment and physical validation are unperformed.
